title: Material3 Select Popup RTL v1
problem: Material3 Select trigger label/supporting text now use logical inline edges, but the popup/listbox path still needs RTL proof for popper start alignment and option-row leading/trailing visual slots.

repro.summary: Run focused Select RTL popup/listbox geometry diagnostics tests.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test select_behavior select_rtl_start_aligned_popup_anchors_to_trigger_inline_start
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test select_behavior select_rtl_listbox_items_place_logical_leading_slot_on_right

gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-material3 --features diagnostics --test select_behavior select_rtl_start_aligned_popup_anchors_to_trigger_inline_start

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed after Select popup/listbox RTL placement and option-row proof. Split trigger input-row RTL, ExposedDropdown/Autocomplete adoption, and broader field-family choreography into follow-ons.
